## 3a8b7b814eb5

**Finding type: reproduced orientation shortcut. No source edits were made.** Audited generator SHA-256: `1314e70f9d7d2936421f207c4ececb95d61550cc0f4607eeb87b321aabc629a0`.

The normal sampler was probed for 300 successful draws: 100 per band, sample indices 0–99, seeds `900000 + 41 * index`, with 300 unique inputs and no generation failures. Across 824 same-color point pairs, every pair had northwest-to-southeast orientation; zero had northeast-to-southwest orientation. Thus the plausible rival “fill a rectangle only when the top point is left of the bottom point; leave reverse-diagonal pairs unchanged” fits every sampled normal-domain input.

Canonical train pair 1 is an exact counterexample. Its color-4 points form a northeast-to-southwest diagonal and the intended rule fills their rectangle; the rival leaves those two cells unchanged while still handling the color-2 northwest-to-southeast pair. `checks/audit/3a8b7b814eb5/input.json` is the exact validator-accepted input (`self_check=[]`). Racket execution used rule hash `21c51d2f4950` and rule-text SHA `c0dac6a842cbf675a5256be9544d6b69e00fff3703e3909f42c7bde81524c9e4`; its output matches the canonical expected output and differs from the rival.
